title: Tafsīr Niẓām al-Qurʾān wa-taʾwīl al-Furqān bi-l-Furqān
author: Ḥamīd al-Dīn al-Farāhī (d. 1930)
edition: Arabic; incomplete, sūra fascicles published from 1930s (Azamgarh: Dāʾira Ḥamīdiyya); Urdu tr. by Islahi, Majmūʿa-yi Tafāsīr-i Farāhī (1973). English: Exordium to Coherence in the Qur'an (tr. Tariq Mahmood Hashmi, 2008) = the introduction (from memory — verify)
coverage: c. 14 sūras: al-Fātiḥa, al-Dhāriyāt, al-Taḥrīm, al-Qiyāma, al-Mursalāt, ʿAbasa, al-Shams, al-Tīn, al-ʿAṣr, al-Fīl, al-Kawthar, al-Kāfirūn, al-Lahab/Tabbat, al-Ikhlāṣ (from memory — verify)
